scientific_integrity: The result is an analytic self-review of a fixed Laplacian classification, supported by an explicit proof and finite exact checker. Independently validated research is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Unweighted undirected simple cycle bouquets sharing a single hub only; at least two petals of length at least three.
Independent unit-coordinate actuation, exact Kalman controllability and ordinary graph zero forcing, not generic-weight or strong structural controllability.
Full text of Liu--Ji (2017), Dong et al. (2023) and Guo et al. (2024) remained inaccessible, leaving potential antecedents unresolved.
title: Exact actuator count below zero forcing for bouquets of arbitrary cycles
